page.overview:
What is Abbey of Highsong?

The Abbey of Highsong, formerly Tharthyn Villa, was a temple to Milil located on the Sword Coast in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

It stood on the Coast Way some distance northwest of the town of Nashkel in the Cloud Peaks.

The temple was built by the Sorlyn priest Velmos Sonder after he acquired Wythyndle's Round Book, circa 1360 DR. It was built in an old country villa that once belonged to the Tharthyn family. Sonder titled himself Laurel Lord of Song.

The newly opened abbey quickly began to flourish, attracting many wealthy and aimless young folks from Amn and Baldur's Gate. However, three years after the abbey's founding, Velmos was murdered, found dead in a pool of blood in the main hall of the abbey's Inner Gallery. The sacred Round Book also disappeared, having seemingly been stolen during Velmos's murder. Both crimes had yet to be solved as of 1368 DR.
